theorem_candidate: For L_n={w: the n-th symbol from the right is 1}, every exact deterministic sufficient-state machine has at least 2^n states; 2^n states suffice.
note: Pairwise distinguishability was independently regression-tested for n=1..8 before freezing this result. The committed checker extends the same exact test through n=10. The mechanism is classical Myhill-Nerode / deterministic state complexity and is retained as a collision boundary, not a novelty claim.
